# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 18 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_018_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 18

**18:1** And he found a cave there and brought her into it. And he left his sons with her and went out to seek a Hebrew midwife in the region of Bethlehem.

**18:2** Now I, Joseph, was walking, and I walked and yet did not walk. And I looked up to the vault of heaven and saw it standing still, and then at the air, and I saw the air in amazement. And I looked at the birds of heaven, and they were stationary. And I looked down at the earth, and I saw a vessel lying there and workers reclining beside it, with their hands in the vessel. And those who were chewing were not chewing. And those who were lifting something were not lifting it. And those who were raising something to their mouths were not raising it. And the faces of all were looking upward.

**18:3** And I saw sheep being driven and the sheep stood still. And the shepherd raised his hand to strike them, and his hand remained upward. And I saw the stream of a river and the mouths of the kids bowed down toward the water and were not drinking. And then all at once everything went on its course again.

**18:4** And behold, a woman came down from the hillside, and she said to me, "Man, where are you going?" And I said, "I am seeking a Hebrew midwife." And answering, she said to me, "Are you from Israel?" And I said to her, "Yes." And she said, "And who is she who is in labor in the cave?" And I said, "She is my betrothed." And she said to me, "Is she not your wife?" And I said to her, "She is Mary who was reared in the temple of the Lord, and I received her by lot as my wife, and she is not my wife but has conceived by the Holy Spirit."

**18:5** And the midwife said to him, "Is this true?" And Joseph said to her, "Come and see." And the midwife went with him.
